label.zh-TW: App Store：VoiceTube 影音字典（開發者網站為 tw.voicetube.com）
label.en: App Store: VoiceTube Dictionary (developer website on tw.voicetube.com)

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟分享連結（voice.tube 短網址，沒有邀請碼）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the share link (a voice.tube short link; there is no code).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示開啟或下載 App，請只安裝 App 商店中的官方版本。
steps.en: Follow the page to open or download the app, and install only the official version from the app store.

steps.zh-TW: 開啟 App 後依指示使用；是否需要註冊或登入，以 App 內畫面為準。
steps.en: Open the app and follow its prompts; whether it asks you to register or log in is shown in the app.

intro.zh-TW: VoiceTube 影音字典 App 的分享連結；分享文案只有名稱，沒有提到邀請碼或優惠。
intro.en: Share link for the VoiceTube Dictionary app; the share text has only the name, no code or offer.

description.zh-TW:
VoiceTube 影音字典是英漢字典 App，可離線查單字，也有發音與影片例句，和 VoiceTube 看影片學英語是同一家公司的不同產品。App 可免費下載，App Store 標示含廣告。

本頁連結是分享文案中的 voice.tube 短網址，會轉到字典 App 連結頁，沒有邀請碼。分享文案沒有提到優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
VoiceTube Dictionary (VoiceTube 影音字典) is an English-Chinese dictionary app with offline lookup, pronunciation and video example sentences. It is a separate product from VoiceTube, the video-based English learning service, and comes from the same company. The app is free to download, and its App Store listing says it contains ads.

The link on this page is the voice.tube short link from the share text; it leads to an app-link page for the dictionary app and carries no invite code. The share text mentions no offer, so none is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案只有名稱，連結原樣保留。2026-10-24 以瀏覽器開啟，voice.tube 會轉到 applinks.voicetube.com 的 App 連結頁，頁面內容是字典 App 介紹，轉址網址帶有邀請人參數。這是字典 App，與「VoiceTube 看影片學英語」是不同的產品。是否綁定邀請人未查證。註冊時邀請關係是否被接受，沒有測試。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。
notes.en: The share text is only the app name, and the link is kept exactly as shared. Opened in a browser on 2026-10-24, voice.tube redirected to an app-link page on applinks.voicetube.com whose content describes the dictionary app, and the redirect address carries an inviter parameter. This is the dictionary app, a different product from VoiceTube 看影片學英語. Whether the link is tied to a referrer was not checked. Whether a referral is accepted at sign-up was not tested. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

q.zh-TW: VoiceTube 影音字典的分享連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need an invite code for the VoiceTube Dictionary share link?

a.zh-TW: 本站沒有邀請碼可提供：分享文案沒有邀請碼，網址最後的 bPQHab3o 是否為邀請碼，本站讀到的 VoiceTube 頁面沒有說明，所以不列為邀請碼。請直接透過本頁連結開啟。
a.en: This site has no invite code to give: the share text has none, and the VoiceTube pages read here do not say whether the end of the address, bPQHab3o, is a code, so it is not listed as one. Open the link on this page.

q.zh-TW: 透過這條連結安裝 App 有優惠嗎？
q.en: Is there an offer for installing the app through this link?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有提到優惠，本站讀到的 VoiceTube 官方頁面也沒有說明這條連結的優惠，所以不列出優惠。
a.en: The share text mentions no offer, and the official VoiceTube pages read here describe none for this link, so none is listed.
